crates/reflow2-core/tests/decision_overtaken_by_promotion.rs — 10 tests.

POSITIVES (all 5 fail when the sweep call is disabled): an idea promoted into an accepted Requirement raises one finding anchored to BOTH the question and what answered it, with its denominator in the evidence; closing the decision clears it; an idea that shipped as a recorded ChangeEvent is asked about (the class the hand sweep missed); an idea that became a DesignRule in force is asked about; a second promotion moves the gap id so an acknowledgement of the first does not silence it.

EXCLUSIONS (all 3 fail when the settled rule is widened to accept any target): a promotion still at `proposed` is intent, not settlement; a `dropped` promotion reopens the question rather than settling it; a TemporalFact target is evidence toward an answer, not the answer.

TWO SILENCE TESTS that cannot fail by construction, and are honest about it: a parked question goes quiet; an answer nobody linked back is out of reach — the second exists to DOCUMENT the blind spot the detector's own evidence line states, not to prove anything.
properties.name: The promotion detector's ten tests, falsified in both directions
